script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Family
Theme: ambition

Begin screenplay.

---

FADE IN:

INT. KITCHEN - MORNING

Mrs. LEE (50s, kind, nurturing) prepares breakfast, humming to herself.

The door opens. MR. LEE (50s, stern, hardworking) enters, wearing a suit and holding a newspaper.

MR. LEE
(disappointed)
You're not up yet? I thought we'd agreed that you'd wake up earlier to help with the kids.

Mrs. LEE
(apologetic)
I'm sorry, I'll make it up to you. I promise.

MR. LEE
(sighs)
It's not just about helping with the kids. I want you to pursue your ambitions.

Mrs. LEE
(confused)
What ambitions? I thought my ambition was being a good wife and mother.

MR. LEE
(frustrated)
That's not enough for you?

Mrs. LEE
(tearful)
Yes, it is. I love being a mother, but I also want to do something for myself.

MR. LEE
(softening)
Then what is it? What do you want to do?

Mrs. LEE
(hesitant)
I've always loved cooking. I'd like to start my own food blog.

MR. LEE
(smiling)
That's wonderful, dear. I'll support you.

---

INT. LIVING ROOM - LATER THAT DAY

Mrs. LEE sets up her laptop on the coffee table. The children, JASON (8) and EMMA (6), watch curiously.

MRS. LEE
(excited)
This is the start of my food blog, "Mom's Kitchen Delights." I want to share my recipes and cooking tips with other parents.

JASON
(interested)
Can we help you, Mom?

MRS. LEE
(smiling)
Absolutely. You can help me test out the recipes and give me feedback.

---

INT. KITCHEN - EVENING

Mrs. LEE cooks dinner while the children do their homework at the table.

MR. LEE enters, wearing a relaxed expression.

MR. LEE
(proud)
You're doing great, honey. Keep up the good work.

---

EXT. PARK - NEXT MORNING

Mrs. LEE takes a break from her blog to enjoy the fresh air with the children.

They play on the swings and share stories about their day.

---

INT. LIVING ROOM - LATER THAT DAY

Mrs. LEE receives an email notification on her laptop.

She reads the email aloud to her family.

MRS. LEE
(elated)
"Mom's Kitchen Delights" has been featured on a popular food blog!

MR. LEE
(grinning)
I told you you were good.

JASON and EMMA
(cheering)
Yeah, Mom!

---

INT. KITCHEN - NIGHT

Mrs. LEE cooks dinner for her family, feeling a sense of accomplishment.

MR. LEE sits at the table, smiling at his wife.

MR. LEE
You've found your ambition, and you're succeeding at it. I'm so proud of you.

Mrs. LEE
(grateful)
Thank you, dear. I couldn't have done it without your support.

---

EXT. HOUSE - NIGHT

The family gathers around the outdoor patio table for a picnic dinner. They share stories and laughs while enjoying Mrs. Lee's cooking.

---

INT. KITCHEN - MORNING

Mrs. LEE wakes up early to start her day, with a renewed sense of purpose.

MR. LEE enters, wearing a supportive smile.

MR. LEE
(encouraging)
Another day, another recipe. I believe in you.

Mrs. LEE
(determined)
I won't let you down.

---

INT. LIVING ROOM - EVENING

Mrs. LEE receives another email notification, this time from a publishing company.

She reads the email to her family.

MRS. LEE
(excited)
They want to publish my cookbook!

The family cheers and hugs Mrs. Lee, congratulating her on her success.

---

FADE OUT.
